{{Quote|Everybody important shows up when there's a fight. You want to find out who's got a certain something, the person who knows will show if you book one of your buddies for a fight. Arrange it by talking to the Zabrak behind the bar.|Squedge Eepsey, on the fighting circle in The Hutt's Last Laugh|<ref name="Put Up Your Dukes">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021107dukes|text=Put Up Your Dukes|int=Put Up Your Dukes}}</ref>}}
'''Squedge Eepsey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sahl-Evin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jenenma]]. Eepsey was a patron of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[The Hutt's Last Laugh]] in the [[Blinders district]] of Sahl Evin, and at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, a group of agents visited the cantina and encountered Eepsey. The Duros advised the individuals to avoid the cantina's fighting circle.
